title: 2026-2027 OAS - Universidad del Desarrollo Scholarship Opportunity (dLab Global)
official_source: General Secretariat of the Organization of American States (GS/OAS) and Universidad del Desarrollo
official_source_url: https://www.oas.org/en/scholarships/PAEC/2026/2026-2027 OAS - The UDD Scholarship Program Announcement.pdf
description: The GS/OAS and the Universidad del Desarrollo in Chile fund USD 3,400 of the USD 3,800 total course fee for a 4-month online certificate in Global Innovation and Entrepreneurship (dLab Global 2026), focused on SDG 13 climate action. The selected candidate remains responsible for USD 400 of the course fee, plus study materials or equipment, internet access, and any additional fees not included in the offer. Living costs, travel and insurance are not addressed at all in the announcement, so this is not full funding and there is no stipend to live on.

description: The SG/OAS awards tuition discounts for online postgraduate study with UNIR (Spain), the Escuela de Posgrado Peruana de NEWMAN (Peru) and UNIR Mexico. Up to 885 places are offered, with a 60% discount on total tuition for official master's programmes and official degrees, and a 50% discount for UNIR Formación Permanente programmes, applicable only to the value of the study programme. title: KAUST Fellowship (Master's, Ph.D. and M.S./Ph.D. Pathway)
official_source: King Abdullah University of Science and Technology (KAUST)
duration: M.S. is a 36-credit program expected to be completed in three semesters and one summer session; the M.S./Ph.D. pathway typically takes five to six years
description: The KAUST Fellowship is awarded automatically to admitted graduate students at King Abdullah University of Science and Technology in Thuwal, Saudi Arabia. The published package covers full tuition and bench fees (stated as worth up to USD $35,000 per year), a monthly stipend (stated as worth USD $20,000 per year for M.S. students and USD $25,000 to $30,000 per year for Ph.D. students depending on qualifications and academic progress), base on-campus accommodation, health insurance for students and eligible dependents living on campus, and relocation support covering visa, relocation and travel

title: MBZUAI Graduate Funding for M.Sc. and Ph.D. Students
official_source: Mohamed bin Zayed University of Artificial Intelligence (MBZUAI)
duration: M.Sc.: full-time, on campus, 36 credits (coursework in the first year, thesis research in the second year, plus a master's internship of up to six weeks). Ph.D.: full-time, on campus, 60 credits, with thesis research pursued for a period of three (3) to four (4) years.
description: MBZUAI's graduate funding is not a single named scholarship but a University-and-faculty funding model under which funded M.Sc. and Ph.D. students receive free tuition fees, a monthly stipend, one return airfare each year to their home country, health insurance for the approved funding period, and a University-sponsored UAE residence visa and Emirates ID where eligible. Ph.D. Year 1 funding is centrally funded by the University while the student is matched with a faculty advisor, and funding moves to the faculty advisor's funding no later than the start of Year 2. official_source: Hamad Bin Khalifa University (HBKU), a member of Qatar Foundation for Education, Science, and Community Development
duration: Stipend duration of 45 months for PhD programmes and 21 months for Master's programmes

official_source: United Arab Emirates Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MOFA)

title: Career Development Fellowship
description: The Career Development Fellowship provides the most talented early career scientists from underrepresented groups in STEM with research funding and high-quality training opportunities to build a strong base for a successful research career. It is currently offered as a pilot with researchers from Black heritage backgrounds and, if successful, may be broadened to researchers from other underrepresented groups.
